book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Luka

content: Yesu bumpeleka kwaka Pilatu
Ndipala boka batenda kujema, nu kumpeleka Yesu kwaka Pilatu.
Batumbuliya kuntakii koni bakapwaga, “Tunkoli mundu ajo jaahoa bandu biito kwa malobi gisoli. Jaakana bandu kulepa kodi kwaka nkolongu juku Loma, jupwaaga jombi ndi Kilisitu, Bambo nkolongu.”
Pilatu andalukiya Yesu, “Boo, we lee Bambu Nkolongu wa Ayaude?” Yesu jajibua, “Ngati egupwagiki weapa.”
Ndienu Pilatu jaapwagila agolu akolongu nu nsambi wa bandu bala, “Ngase nilibweni likosa lokapi lejutei mundu jonzo.”
Lakini bombi bahingamaki ngamaa koni apwaaga, “Kupetea mabolee gaki jaakwelake bandu baabii ku ndema juku Yudea. Jatumbuliya ku Galilaya mbaka kongo.”
Yesu bumpeleka kwaka Helodi
Pilatu pajajogwa haga, andalukiya, “Boo, mundu hoju mwenei juku Galilaya?”
Pilatu pajamanya Yesu jahumi mundema jejitawala Helodi, ampelika kwaka Helodi, jojabii ku Yelusalemu masoba gegala.
Helodi pa ambona Yesu, jatogulii ngamaa ndaba masoba gingi japala kumbona. Jabia jujoini majambu gaki na japala jubona ndonduke kuhuma kwaki.
Helodi andalukiya Yesu malobi gingi lakini Yesu ngasejajibwiki sokapi.
Agolu akolongu na aka abola ba Malagalaki bajemiki pala, bumpikia Yesu magambu gingi kwa makili ngamaa.
Helodi na alonda baki bunhengila Yesu liyaa nu kundongama. Bunhwatika ingobu ya sapi ngamaa ngati laka bambu nkolongu, nu kunkelabuu kwaka Pilatu.
Tumbuka lisoba le leli, Helodi jabia nkosi waka Pilatu, kabula ja masoba gu munyuma batenda kusukiana.
Yesu antemu kuwa
Ndienu, Pilatu jaakema pamu aka agolu akolongu, aka kilongosi na bandu,
jaapwagila, “Mundetiki mundu ajoo kwangu ngati jojaakonga bandu. Ne nundaluki palongi jinu, lakini ngasenilibweni likosa lokapi lemuntakali.
Najombi Helodi ahelahe ankelabwi mundu jonzo kwitu, ndaba ngasejilibweni likosa lake. Henu mundu jonzo ngase jatei sokapi sesunhenga kuwa.
Henu nagalaki mundapula iboku, ndi mundekakiya jujenda.”
Kila lisoba la tipati ja Pasaka, Pilatu jwayobali kundekake mpungwa jumu.
Lakini bandu boti bajamaliya pamwa, “Gunkoma mundu hoju, utubopuliya Balaba!”
Balaba jabia mundu joankongiki mkipungu ndaba jukusababisa puju jejapiti kumusi nukukoma bandu.
Pilatu japala kundekake Yesu, henu jalongila nabu kabee.
Lakini bombi bajamalya kwa sauti, “Mumbambaliya mu nsalaba! Mumbambaliya mu nsalaba!”
Pilatu jaapwagila kwa mala ja tatu, “Ndaba ja kike? Boo jutei likosa boo mundu we jone? Ngase nilibweni likosa lokapi leluntenda mbaka kunkoma. Henu nu ndapu iboku ya ndomondo nu kundekakela.”
Lakini bombi baendalya kujamali kwa sauti ngolongu ngamaa, bapala ambambaliya Yesu mu nsalaba. Kujamali kwabu buntenda Pilatu jujetakiya.
Ndienu Pilatu jaamua sebapala bandu bala kihengika.
Andekakiya mundu jobumpala jola, jobummbei mukipungu jojwatei puju nukukoma bandu na kwaapeke Yesu bunhengila seapala.
Yesu ammbambika mu nsalaba
Pababia bumpeleka, baketangana na mundu jumu jobunkema Simoni, mwenei juku Kilene, jojabia juhuma ku litui. Ndipala bunkamula, buntweka nsalaba we gola ili jutotula su munyuma jaka Yesu.
Nsambi nkolongu wa bandu unkagula Yesu, pamu na aka mbomba bababia alobalake nu kundele Yesu.
Yesu jaang'anumbukiya na kwaapwaagi, “Mbanganya mwa aka mbomba buku Yelusalemu, mwinele nenga, ila nndela ndaba jinu mwabeti na bana bino.
Ndaba gahika masoba pabipwaga, ‘Nambanga banga akambonga banga kubeleka, banga kuwai kupata bana wala mabeli gangakujongesa bana!’
Masoba ge haga, bandu pa biitumbuka kiipwagi itombi, ‘Mtuhabukiya!’ Ni itombi isoku, ‘Mtuyelalya!’
Ana bandu ahengiki hela ku nkongu mmbei, kwibia boo ku nkongu nzomu?”
Bandu bangi abeli bababii baahenga galiya baapeliki pamu na Yesu ili bakaabambaliya.
Pabahika pandu pabapakema, “Lihupa lu Umutu” Ndienu bummbambaliya Yesu pamu na bababi baahenga galiya abeli bala kila mundu nu nsalaba waki, jumu upandi waki wamalele na jongi upandi waki wamangega.
Yesu japwaga “Atati! Waalekakiya mahakahu gabu ndaba ngase amanyiki se ahenga.” Ndienu alonda bala bapega gudugudu ili kubagana ingobu yaki.

Bandu babia ajemiki pala buku ndingalya, na akakolongu ba Ayaudi babia bundongama Yesu bakapwaga, “Jaakombwi bandu bangi, henu julikombula mweni, ana jombi ndi Kilisitu Nkombosi jojuhaguliwi na Sapanga!”
Ahelahe alonda batenda kundongama kabee, bunzendila nu kumpeke divai jejibabiki,
nabombi bumpwagila, “Ana sakaka weapa Bambu Nkolongu wa Ayaudi, ulikombula wamwete!”
Panani ju nsalaba waki babia ahandiki malobi ganga, “Jonzo ndi Bambu Nkolongu jwa Ayaudi.”
Jumu jojabii jojuhenga galiya babaambalii mu nsalaba antondula Yesu nu kupwaga, “Weapa le nga wi Kilisitu? Ulikombula wamweti na twe utumbula!”
Lakini jojuhenga giliyaa jongi jola andakaliya nzaki juliyaa jola nu kupwagi, “Boo weapa ngase gunzogopa Sapanga? Wehapa bukutemu ngati jombi.
Weapa na nepani bututemwi ngati ekupalika, ndienu tujopiki malepu ga mahengu gitu, lakini mundu jonzo ngasejatei sindu siliya.”
Ndipala mundu jola ampwagila Yesu, “Waa Yesu, egwihika mu Ukolongu waku gwingombuka.”
Yesu japwaga, “Nugupwagi sakaka lelenu gwiibiya pamu nane pandu pa laha pabapakema Paladiso.”
Yesu jukuwa punsalaba
Kwabiya saa sita lyoba mutu, lwahika lwii nndema gwooti mbaka saa tisa.
Ndipala, lipazia la Nyumba jaka Sapanga lajenduka hipandi ibele.
Yesu jajamaliya kwa sauti ngolongu, japwaaga, “Atati, Mwamaboku gaku nijibeka loho jango!” Ejapwaaga hela jwatendakuwa.
Nkolongu ja alonda miya moja juku Loma jola pajabona gagapiti, andumbaliya Sapanga nukupwaaga, “Sakaka mundu jonzo jabii jwaamboni.”
Bandu boka bababii ahikiki kulingali lijambu heli, pabagabona gagapiti, bajenda mwama nyumba gabu, koni abii nu usungu.
Lakini bandu boti babummanyiki Yesu bajeema su kutali ili bagabona majambu ge haga. Kati jabu babii aka mbomba babunzengali Yesu kuhuma ku Galilaya.
Yesu atenda kuntaga
Jabii mundu jumu, lihina laki Josepu jojahumi ku Alimataya musi uku Yudea. Mundu we hoju jwabii jwa amboni na jabii juhenga majambu ga amboni na jabia julendale Ukolongu waka Sapanga.
Hata ngati Alimatayo jabii jumu kati ja akolongu ba pasengu ja Ayaudi. Lakini ngasejajetaki sebahenga ajake,
Josepu jajenda kwaka Pilatu, kuloba nhyega jaka Yesu.
Henu jahulua kuhuma pu nsalaba, jijiwatika sanda, jugubeka pilitenge lelabii ahembiki pi lilibu, lelule ngasebawaiki kuntaga mundu.
Lisoba lee heli labii lijumaa, lisoba le heli labi lisoba lukutumbuli Lisoba lu Kupomulela.
Aka mbomba bala bababii ampwatiki Yesu kuhuma ku Galilaya bumpwata Josepu, na bilibona litenge lela na ebabei nhyega jaka Yesu.
Ndipala babujaninya ku nyumba, baandia mahuta gaganungi sapi ili bijipakia nhyega jaka Yesu. Lisoba lu Kupomulela bapomulya ngati Malagalaki gaka Sapanga egapwaaga.
